culprit_citations.quoted_text: Industry | Issuer | Acquisition Date | Investment | % of Net Assets | Par Amount | Maturity Date | Amortized Cost | Fair Value

findings.detail: B01 reports only 37 of 74 extracted leaves have fair_value, but the current-period SOI has a Fair Value column populated on investment rows and totals.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate review. The raw SOI tables expose a Fair Value column for the investment schedule and populate it on current-period investment rows, for example Hudson Technologies Company at table 5 row 4 with fair value 6,059,560. The schedule anchors also provide current-period debt fair value of 403,510,457 and total investments fair value of 686,157,510 at table 6 rows 21 and 29. Because the source carries fair values while the B01 artifact reports only 37/74 leaves with fair_value, the failure is a real extraction/completeness gap rather than a source omission.
